# Matthew Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old at the beginning of the series; died at sixty-eight
- **Gender:** Male
- **Status:** Deceased
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island, Canada
- **Role:** Farmer

## Appearance

Matthew was an awkwardly shaped man with stooped shoulders and dark hair sprinkled with gray. He wore a full, soft brown beard that he had kept since he was twenty years old. He dressed plainly in simple farm clothes and usually walked with a diffident, shy posture.

## Personality

Matthew was extraordinarily shy, quiet, and reclusive, possessing a deep terror of women and young girls. Beneath his silent and awkward exterior lay an immensely kind, gentle, and generous heart. He formed an immediate, intuitive bond with Anne, understanding her imaginative nature and quiet yearnings better than anyone else. He was incapable of being harsh with those he loved and took quiet joy in spoiling Anne whenever he could.

## Traits

- Painfully shy and reserved
- Deeply affectionate and kind-hearted
- Fearful of women and young girls
- Indulgent and generous toward Anne
- Hardworking and quiet

## Abilities

- Skilled at traditional farming
- Gentle handling of horses and livestock

## Goals

- Provide a good life and education for Anne Shirley
- Maintain the Cuthbert family farm at Green Gables

## History

Matthew Cuthbert lived a quiet life at Green Gables with his unmarried sister Marilla, working their farm in Avonlea. As he grew older and his health began to decline, he and Marilla decided to adopt an orphan boy to help with the farm work. Through a misunderstanding, a young girl named Anne Shirley arrived at the train station instead, but Matthew was instantly captivated by her spirit and convinced Marilla to keep her. Over the following years, Matthew served as Anne's quiet advocate, buying her a puffed-sleeve dress she longed for and constantly encouraging her academic pursuits. His health gradually weakened due to heart trouble, though he remained devoted to Anne as she grew into a young woman and earned her B.A. degree. Matthew passed away suddenly from a heart attack caused by the shock of the Abbey Bank failure, leaving behind a profound legacy of love that shaped Anne's life.

## Background by volume

- Lived his entire life at Green Gables in Avonlea with his sister Marilla
- Suffered from a weak heart for many years
- Had a brother who died in youth

## Affiliations

- The Cuthbert Family — Head of household and farmer
